title: Estimate a first-order rate constant from noisy decay data
research_question: What is the rate constant k (and half-life) of a first-order decay observed as a noisy time series?
task_objective: Fit a first-order kinetic model to the provided signal and report k and the half-life, with a figure of data + fit.
expected_outputs: figures/decay.png showing the data points and the fitted curve
task_description: A reproduction task: load the signal, fit a first-order decay, report k and half-life.
